eval_days_short_without_topup.note: series-days of days 0..last_day on which the regular deliveries alone (after the simulation's earlier top-ups) would not cover the public units; the simulation tops them up so its record stays equal to the public units, and stock.topup_on_eval_days says whether those top-ups reach the worlds (D-39); a simulated result, never observed in the public dataset

note: Consistency figures of the simulated stock against the public sales; reported, not tuned; the stock is simulated, never observed
product_category_rule: a product's category codes come from its first series in code order; a product whose codes differ between stores is counted in product_category_conflicts
weather_rule: weather is a column of every product row; when products of one store-day disagree, the first product in code order is kept and the store-day is counted in weather_conflicts
